title: oh, apparently it's not possible to portably check for string-to-float conversion errors in standard c

comments.comment:
Sometimes I get tired of working in higher-level languages like Python and I feel inspired to try my hand at something lower-level and closer to the machine. Go and Java are too corporate, Zig and Odin and Hare are too trendy, Rust is too industrial and C++ too Lovecraftian.

"I know", I say, "I'll use C - it's been around for fifty years, it's small and simple and got to be polished to a sheen by now." Then I read an article like this one.

Maybe I need to look more into Forth...
